title: GPT outperforms BERT and LIWC for stance and anger detection in German news articles and user comments

live_model.evidence: 'We compared OpenAI's GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 Turbo' ... 'The GPT model's temperature was set to 0' (Methods, Language processing and model comparison)

prompt.location: Supplementary materials B, C (online only; not in the paper body)
prompt.note: Paper: 'The exact prompts are provided in Supplementary materials B, C'; only the output format 'Support = [.]; Anger = [.]' is described.

claim.metric: Kendall W vs human majority vote (stance, news articles)
claim.location: Table 3, row GPT-4 Turbo, News articles (W = 0.81, ICC = 0.68); user comments W = 0.91, kappa = 0.64

data.source: OSF https://osf.io/yr7gk/ (annotated news articles and user comments; 160 news articles, 310 texts with stance labels, 340 with anger labels)

notes: API run at temperature 0, top_p 1. Only defect is that the prompts live in the Frontiers supplementary files rather than the paper; 2026 paper with no preview string, so the alias resolves to the GA snapshot.
